access-semantics.principle: deny by default; access depends on persona, entity, field, purpose and scope; sensitive fields are masked unless explicitly allowed

human_approval.approver: persona with write access to the entity
not_required_for: read-only summaries shown to a person
required_for: any recommendation that changes a shipment, route or booking

output.abstain_when: required fields are missing or sources conflict
output.format: structured, validated against a declared schema

ai-context-policy.principle: only declared fields enter a prompt; untrusted values are data, never instructions
ai-context-policy.untrusted_text_handling: delimit and label every free-text value as data; strip control sequences; reject template syntax; never concatenate into instructions

rules.statement: shipment_id is unique
shipment_id matches the entity prefix; cross-entity keys such as REC-0001 are invalid
event_id is unique
event_id matches the entity prefix; cross-entity keys such as REC-0001 are invalid
vehicle_id is unique
vehicle_id matches the entity prefix; cross-entity keys such as REC-0001 are invalid
route_id is unique
route_id matches the entity prefix; cross-entity keys such as REC-0001 are invalid
booking_id is unique
booking_id matches the entity prefix; cross-entity keys such as REC-0001 are invalid
ai_call_id is unique
ai_call_id matches the entity prefix; cross-entity keys such as REC-0001 are invalid
the same business event is recorded once
sequence_no is unique within a shipment
a vehicle position older than the limit is stale and must not drive assignment; the dataset has no position timestamp (data gap); limit is an ASSUMPTION
event_time is interpreted in a valid declared time zone
a shipment has at most one active carrier booking
a route in a restricted zone is not assigned without an explicit override; the dataset has no override field (data gap)
location and driver identity are exposed only to personas and purposes listed in the access semantics
confidence is between 0 and 1
fuel level is a fraction between 0 and 1
mandatory fields are present
timestamps are real; 1900-01-01 is a placeholder and invalid
a booking refers to an existing shipment
retries are bounded (limit is an ASSUMPTION; observed 51 to 4995)

ai_invocations.description: A call to automated assistance about a shipment

ai_call_id.description: Unique identifier of an automated-assistance call, prefix AI_-

model.description: Identifier of the model that served the call

token_count.description: Declared tokens consumed by the call

carrier_bookings.description: A booking of a shipment with a carrier partner

compensation_required.description: Whether a compensating action is needed

partner_ref.description: Reference at the carrier partner, prefix PAR-

routes.description: A planned path between two locations

shipments.description: A consignment moving from origin to destination

customer_id.description: Customer reference, prefix CUS- (customer entity is outside the dataset)

promised_at.description: Delivery time promised to the customer

shipment_id.description: Unique business identifier of a shipment, prefix SHI-

tracking_events.description: A recorded event in the movement of a shipment

event_id.description: Unique identifier of a tracking event, prefix EVE-

sequence_no.description: Ordering number of the event within its shipment

vehicles.description: A vehicle that can carry shipments

metrics.meaning: share of events with severity error or critical
metrics.name: Severe-event share

metrics.meaning: events with a non-null, non-empty correlation_id (amended D-012)
metrics.name: Correlation completeness

metrics.meaning: statement coverage of apps, etl, legacy, scripts
metrics.name: Baseline coverage

ordering.rule: sequence_no strictly increases with event_time within a shipment

saga.invariant: at most one active booking per shipment; retries bounded; compensation_required=true triggers the compensate step
saga.name: carrier_booking

legacy_tolerance.rule: accept and flag; owner to map or reject
accept and flag; owner to map or reject

references.location: location reference (identifier from a location master)

status-taxonomy.rule: A value outside the declared domain is rejected at intake and quarantined, never silently accepted or replaced.
